title: Turnover package and validation documents | Aquemi
meta: Every document delivered with our polypropylene Purified Water package, by stage: URS compliance matrix, P&IDs, material certificates, joint records, FAT and IQ/OQ protocols. Request an Aquemi-written specimen package.
eyebrow: DOCUMENTATION · EU GMP ANNEX 15 · GUI-0029 · GAMP 5
headline: Every document your auditor asks for
lead: We write each document as we design, build and test your polypropylene (PP) Purified Water package. Each line of your user requirement specification (URS) traces to the document proving it.

blocks.h: The turnover package, section by section
blocks.intro: Documents handed over with your system.

URS compliance matrix, basis of design, risk assessment, design review report, traceability matrix, commissioning and qualification (C&Q) plan
Functional and design specifications, alarm list, Part 11 and Annex 11 assessment
Piping and instrumentation diagrams (P&IDs), general arrangement, isometrics, process flow diagram, balances, membrane projections, loop hydraulics
[PP material certificates] by lot, to [PP material standard]; [elastomer certificates per compound]; [certificates supplied for PVC parts]; media, resin and component certificates
Fabrication and inspection plan; [PP joining method] procedure, welder qualifications, [PP joint records kept]
Slope survey; dead leg register to [dead leg design limit, L/D]; spray coverage test; cleaning certificate after [pre-commissioning flush and cleaning procedure for PP]

Calibration certificates, traceable via [calibration provider and accreditation held]; total organic carbon system suitability, where an analyzer is fitted; vent filter integrity test
Version and checksum record, code review, baseline backup, audit trail review, backup and restore procedure
Factory and site acceptance test (FAT, SAT), installation, operational and performance qualification (IQ, OQ, PQ) protocols and reports. Deviation logs, sanitization records.
Operation and maintenance manual, draft operating procedures, spare parts list for the first [months of operation], training records

fields.label: Documents you want
options: FAT protocol: contents and test cases

items.q: Can we see real documents before we order?
items.a: As a new company, we send an Aquemi-written [specimen package]: the package index, protocol contents and record formats, shared [openly or under NDA]. Audit our quality system from [quality system ready for audit, date].

items.q: Do you check third-party certificates, or just forward them?
items.a: We check them: markings and lot numbers against the certificate at receipt. Certificates reach you as the issuer sent them, never retyped.

items.q: When do we see the protocols?
items.a: [protocol issue before FAT, weeks] before testing, the factory acceptance test (FAT) protocol reaches your quality unit for approval. Installation and operational qualification (IQ, OQ) protocols follow. They cite the FAT results your quality unit agreed to reuse (EU good manufacturing practice Annex 15, 3.6; GUI-0029, 8.1).
